question: 假如活动期间每天都进行获奖评比并且赠送礼物，那么准备所有奖项的礼物要花多少钱？

steps.description: Locate the number of first prize winners in the image and read the count
Find the first prize gift value in the image and read the amount
Multiply the first prize winner count by the first prize gift value to get total first prize cost
Locate the number of second prize winners in the image and read the count
Find the second prize gift value in the image and read the amount
Multiply the second prize winner count by the second prize gift value to get total second prize cost
Locate the number of third prize winners in the image and read the count
Find the third prize gift value in the image and read the amount
Multiply the third prize winner count by the third prize gift value to get total third prize cost
Add the total first prize cost, second prize cost, and third prize cost to get daily total gift value
Locate the event start date in the image and read the date
Locate the event end date in the image and read the date
Calculate the total number of event days by subtracting start date from end date and adding 1
Multiply the daily total gift value by the total number of event days to get total cost for all gifts
